name: piral-react19-vite8-example
description: Example website using Piral with pilets, React 19, Vite 8, and feed.json

scripts.build:emulator: cd my-app && npx piral build --type emulator --bundler vite8
scripts.build:pilet: cd sample-pilet && npx pilet build --bundler vite8
scripts.build: npm run build:emulator && npm run build:pilet && npm run sync:feed && cd my-app && npx piral build --bundler vite8
scripts.start: npm run sync:feed && cd my-app && npx piral debug --port 3000 --bundler vite8
